activities.title: Revised manuscript framing
activities.summary: Worked on the results and related-work sections, incorporating the emerging methodological issue without treating the current experimental interpretation as settled.

activities.title: Supplementary technical learning and note revision

activities.title: Checked replication run
activities.summary: Briefly inspected the running replication experiment to verify that the process was still progressing.

activities.title: Documented revised research question
activities.summary: Updated the experiment log to narrow the main question and recorded the remaining methodological uncertainty and possible follow-up comparisons.

key_observations: The main experiment moved from an implementation concern toward a narrower methodological question: the choice of calibration metric may materially affect the interpretation.
The researcher did not simply continue running experiments; substantial effort went into validating what the metric actually measures.
The lab meeting introduced a potentially useful direction, but it has not yet been established that the related method applies to the current research question.
The replication study was started, but it remains a secondary thread and is not yet producing interpretable results.
The manuscript made meaningful progress in framing the methodological issue, although final results remain premature.

important_uncertainty: The metric investigation suggests a methodological issue, but the desktop evidence does not establish which metric should ultimately be selected.
The paper introduced during the lab meeting may be relevant, but its usefulness to the current project remains unverified.
The replication experiment was still running, so no conclusion should be drawn from today's monitoring event.
The seminar may have informed the notes, but the observable evidence cannot establish how much it contributed.
expected_reflection.possible_next_step: Compare the main result under the candidate calibration metrics on the same outputs before changing the experimental design again.

primary_action.title: Compare the candidate metrics
primary_action.reason: The recurring uncertainty has narrowed to whether metric choice is driving the observed result; a direct comparison on the existing outputs could resolve that question without immediately launching another experiment.

things_not_to_do: Do not recommend another broad literature search before testing the concrete metric question.
Do not treat the newly introduced paper as automatically relevant to the project.
Do not interpret experiment monitoring as substantive experimental work.
Do not tell the researcher to prioritize the replication study over the main methodological question without evidence that its deadline is more urgent.
Do not infer that the manuscript is being neglected because experimentation and methodology received more attention.
Do not claim that the metric question has been resolved.
